from pathlib import Path
import importlib
import sys

root=Path.cwd()
mods=root/"control/tampermonkey_multichat"
sys.path.insert(0,str(mods))
for name in ("bridge_server_continuation","bridge_server_status_compaction","bridge_server_session_bootstrap","bridge_server_hardened","bridge_server_v2","continuation_manager"):
    sys.modules.pop(name,None)
m=importlib.import_module("bridge_server_continuation")
calls=[]

orig_recover=m.recover_unacked_result_heartbeat
orig_maintain=m.continuation.maintain_for_chat
orig_parent=m.current.Handler.do_GET
try:
    m.recover_unacked_result_heartbeat=lambda chat_id: calls.append(("recover",chat_id)) or 0
    m.continuation.maintain_for_chat=lambda **kwargs: calls.append(("maintain",kwargs["chat_id"]))
    m.current.Handler.do_GET=lambda self: calls.append(("parent",self.path))
    h=object.__new__(m.Handler)
    h.path="/next?chat_id=chat-e029-direct&consumer_id=tab-e029-direct"
    h.authorized=lambda: True
    h.do_GET()
finally:
    m.recover_unacked_result_heartbeat=orig_recover
    m.continuation.maintain_for_chat=orig_maintain
    m.current.Handler.do_GET=orig_parent

assert calls==[
    ("recover","chat-e029-direct"),
    ("maintain","chat-e029-direct"),
    ("parent","/next?chat_id=chat-e029-direct&consumer_id=tab-e029-direct"),
]
assert m.Handler.server_version=="PredictionChatWake/1.4-continuation-heartbeat"
print("DIRECT_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE_E029=PASS")
